$comment: Per-repo worker-class overlay for Matou/matou-app (dev-factory#29). Merged BY ID onto the vendored tui/worker-classes.json table (the harness's own classes, which deliberately declare no hosts): a known id has its fields overridden — declaring `hosts` leaves the vendored description intact — and a new id is appended. Read by the factory TUI's Fleet screen (tui/data/worker_classes.py). THREE hosts wear the `swarm` runner-pool label, each runner at capacity 2 (read from each host's ~/forgejo-runner/.runner, 2026-09-22): `matou-workstation` (= matou-dev-server-01, 4 cores / 7 GB — also the idss rehearsal-drive host and the home of the cron-driven classes below), `bens-mac-04` (Linux despite the name, 8 cores / 15 GB) and `elitebook-03` (8 cores / 14 GB). Classes whose workflow is `runs-on: swarm` can land on any of the three — including the e2e drives since the pr-e2e pin came off (all three pass provision-e2e-stack.sh --check with its [minio] clause). The cron-driven classes (reporter, rehearsal-healer, schedule-backstop) run from matou-workstation's crontab only.

classes.name: check-verifications
classes.lock: shared /tmp/matou-swarm.lock (flock -n 9, skips the tick if a triage/swarm run holds it)
classes.writes: the human verification gate: label swaps awaiting-verification -> ready-for-agent (approve) or -> wontfix + closed (reject) resolved by name; issue comments (approval guidance / copied chatter); Mattermost thread confirmations that embed each processed reply id so a rerun never re-acts on the same reply; a re-posted thread when one is missing
classes.stuck_signal: verify.yml's failure() step routes into the healer; a missing verification thread is re-posted rather than stalling the issue; otherwise thin — the poller exits 0 quietly when chat env is unset
classes.invisible_failure_note: the one worker class the vendored table describes only secondhand (it is not shipped by the factory); its failures are gate-visible via the healer hook, unlike the reporter/session-runner exit-0 classes
